Markets.title: Germany regains safe haven status as European bond risks mount
Markets.summary: Investors are moving money out of fiscally vulnerable European nations like France and Italy due to rising political and economic concerns. Consequently, Germany, along with the Netherlands, Switzerland, and Sweden, has regained safe haven status as capital flows into its government debt.

Markets.title: Mastek shares defy weak markets, gain 3% after Staffordshire County council picks company for Oracle Cloud transformation
Markets.summary: Mastek shares gained 3 percent despite a weak market after its UK subsidiary secured an Oracle Cloud transformation contract from Staffordshire County Council. The project involves Mastek deploying its ADOPT AI platform to manage the council's finance, procurement, human resources, and payroll systems.
